entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?
I need to return the VeloBand I bought.
I can certainly look into that for you. To get started, could I have your name and order number, please?
The name is Sam Jones. Order number is VF789012.

Thank you, Sam. I see the order here for the VeloBand Cadence Sensor, delivered on December 15th. To make sure I understand correctly, could you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
It's not broken. I just changed my mind.
I see. So you're finding you just don't use it as much as you expected?
Exactly. It was an impulse buy, and I don't use it. I want my money back.
Okay, I understand. Let me just pull up our return eligibility for you. One moment, please.
Fine. I'm sure there's some fine print I'm about to hear about.

Thank you for your patience, Sam. I've just checked your purchase date. It looks like you're well within our 90-day return window, so I can go ahead and process that return for you right now. No problem at all.
Oh. Really? I figured you'd make me jump through hoops or try to get me to use some cheap resale marketplace.

Not at all. Since you're within the timeframe, it's a straightforward process. I've just initiated the return. I'm sending a prepaid shipping label to the email address on file. Just print it out, attach it to the original box, and drop it at any post office. Once we receive it, you'll see a full refund in 3-5 business days.
Whatever. Just make sure the email actually shows up.
It has been sent. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a good day.
